info.title: ktsu.NoSleep.Tool
info.description: A cross-platform .NET tool that stops a machine from sleeping, dimming, or locking its display while it runs. Installs as the `nosleep` global tool and puts a system tray icon on Windows, macOS, and Linux so keep-awake can be toggled without touching a terminal. Uses native inhibitors on every platform - SetThreadExecutionState on Windows, IOKit power assertions on macOS, and logind or GNOME session inhibitors on Linux - with a headless console mode and an optional duration for servers, CI agents, and scripts.

options.name: --tray
options.description: Show the tray icon even if no desktop session was detected.

options.name: --no-tray
options.description: Stay in the terminal; never show a tray icon.

options.name: --display
options.description: Keep the display lit as well, not just the system awake.

options.name: --reason
options.description:
Reason recorded with the inhibitor, shown by the platform's own
tooling (pmset -g assertions, systemd-inhibit --list).

options.name: --for
options.description:
Stop and exit after a duration: 45s, 90m, 2h, 1h30m.
A bare number means minutes.

options.name: --status
options.description: Print what nosleep can do on this machine, then exit.

options.name: --version
options.description:
Print the version, then exit.
Exit codes: 0 success, 1 the platform refused, 2 the command line was wrong.
